agent_model_usage.note: counts of agent assignments (a run may assign the same model to several agents)

summary.note: Local class-B operational evidence. cost_usd is the harness-reported figure; 0 means the run was subscription/quota-billed, not free. Fields the harness did not report are null, never 0. Runs are not comparable across workflows: task difficulty, grader and harness differ. Status is an outcome proxy, not a quality grade.
